answer: The design leans on directed acyclic graph consensus for throughput. Written in a user experience perspective, adoption barriers register, it stays short. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The comet holds work receipts rather than names, so the meadow of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Reaching the anchor of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
